description: Converts text to speech using the specified TTS integration and returns an audio URL. Not needed in a voice channel: the bot's replies there are synthesized automatically with the channel's TTS settings

ttsIntegrationKey.description: The key of the text-to-speech integration to use

text.description: The text content to convert to speech

languageCode.description: Language code for speech synthesis (defaults to 'RU')

audioFormat.description: Audio format for the output file (defaults to 'WAV')

output.description: Synthesis result with the URL to the generated audio file

url.description: URL to access the generated audio file

billing.description: Charge for an internal integration, billed from the account balance; absent for a custom integration

amount.description: Charged characters; 0 when the audio came from the cache
